act_title: The Transplantation of Human Organs and Tissues Act, 1994
title: Prohibition of removal or transplantation of** **[4][human organs or tissues or both] for any
text:
11. Prohibition of removal or transplantation of [human organs or tissues or both] for any

purpose other than the rapeatic purposes.— No donor and no person empowered to give authority for
the removal of any human organ shall authorise the removal of any [human organ or tissue or both] for
any purpose other than therapeutic purposes.
